name: bottom-sheet
description: A modal sheet. The handle grows it through detents; drag, back, or scrim leaves. Bleed docks; Float insets.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a yes/no decision; use confirm-dialog. Do not add a close icon. Do not use for a sheet that stays up over a map or player.

ux.behaviour: A handle and a title sit above the body; a footer, when present, stays at the bottom
ux.why: You know it is a sheet, what it is for, and the action will not jump away

ux.behaviour: Crossing a detent ticks and the body is the only slot that grows — peek keeps a one-line summary, expanded reveals the rest
ux.why: You grow the sheet without losing the title or the action under your thumb
ux.reducedMotion: Sheet sits at the detent; body content swaps with no motion

ux.behaviour: Drag, back, or scrim calls onDismiss; there is no close X
ux.why: Leaving a sheet should be the same gesture every time

aiHints: Do not add a close IconButton; onDismiss is the way out
Previews render AppBottomSheetChrome; call AppBottomSheet at runtime
Read LocalAppSheetDetent in content to swap peek vs expanded
chrome = AppSheetChrome.Float insets the card; default Bleed docks to the edges
expandable = true for half-to-full; default fits content and skips the half stop
Put actions in footer so they stay put while the body grows
